description: A new connection whose credential is an org credential of class user_unlocked, granted to this principal, while no login of its storing administrator holds an unlock: 409 org_credential_locked, fixed text and no field, decided in session-open step 3, before any worker is asked, so a refused create leaves nothing behind. A user-unlocked org credential is usable for the operators granted it while that administrator holds an unlock (credential-protection §8.2); an unlock belongs to the login that made it (§5.5), so any login of the administrator will do, and the caller's own unlock never matters for it. The surface says that the credential's administrator must unlock and never asks for the operator's passphrase, which cannot help. The target_id input names a target whose one candidate is such a credential. A broker-unlocked org credential, and a reuse, never get it; a personal credential keeps vault_locked.

error.message: the credential's administrator holds no unlock
